Great article. Thanks for sharing.
One small observation, looks like the parameter order mentioned in the constructor
public SlidingWindowLogRateLimiter(Jedis jedis, long windowSize, int limit) {
this.jedis = jedis;
this.limit = limit;
this.windowSize = windowSize;
}
}
wrongly passed from test cases. Window and limit should be interchanged right?
